failure_layer_diagnosis.primary_reason: A single-rollout constituent reference is unstable enough that positive and negative unit effects mix ordinary composition burden with constituent execution noise and shared-state reuse; the registered 12-unit mean cannot identify a stable global composition penalty at the five-point margin.
failure_layer_diagnosis.assumption_scope_reason: The data do not support treating composition cost as a homogeneous global scalar: five units are negative, three zero, and four positive, with large scene/task variation.
failure_layer_diagnosis.operationalization_risk: The frozen simple mean of constituent PCs gives equal task weights even when constituent proposition counts differ, whereas the composed PC is evaluated on the proposition union. This is a diagnostic mismatch only and cannot be used to repair the completed F0 post hoc.
failure_layer_diagnosis.does_not_imply: DeepSeek incapability, absence of all composition effects, memory-coordination failure, or core-principle failure.

post_hoc_diagnostics_not_claims.mechanism_decomposition: C_u approximately equals negative serial-horizon/execution burden plus shared exploration/state-reuse benefit plus constituent-reference noise.
post_hoc_diagnostics_not_claims.notable_terminal_pressure: unit 10011 composed runtime was 1991.56 seconds under a frozen 2000-second episode cap and had C_u=-0.60.
post_hoc_diagnostics_not_claims.diagnostic_only_rule: These observations may seed new hypotheses but may not change the frozen MEMENTO estimator, threshold, units, or completed HOLD decision.

new_problem_review.broad_problem: Predict whether task composition hurts or helps an embodied agent from task topology before execution.
new_problem_review.strongest_reduction: Classical positive/negative subgoal interaction and goal ordering, resource-bounded planning, modern ex-ante agent task-difficulty prediction, and graph/dependency-based agent planning already predict that composition structure and resource pressure change difficulty.
new_problem_review.narrow_residual: A targeted screen asked whether any prespecified executor-side pre-outcome observable remained after matching classical/symbolic goal interaction, resource-bounded planning, generic ex-ante difficulty and constituent-reference quality.
new_problem_review.why_not_a_rescue: The screen did not promote a new problem and did not inspect the fresh holdout outcomes. Context growth, task-state drift, grounding ambiguity and evaluation-budget pressure all reduced to mature neighboring objects rather than defining a new estimand.
new_problem_review.reopen_condition: Only a materially new executor-side observable or intervention, defined before fresh outcomes and not expressible by symbolic goal interaction, context/horizon/resource complexity, task-state management, grounding ambiguity, evaluation budget or generic task-difficulty models, may reopen a future realization.
